instructions.title: How to use Goodbuy
instructions.description: Compare item unit prices side by side so you can quickly spot the best value.

step_1.title: Name the product
step_1.details: Enter the product name if you want to keep comparisons easy to read.

step_2.title: Add weight or volume and price
step_2.details: Enter the total price and the product’s weight or volume so the app can calculate unit cost.

step_3.title: Include shipping if needed
step_3.details: Add shipping cost for a more accurate total unit price.

step_4.title: Review the unit price
step_4.details: Goodbuy shows your unit price using: (Price + Shipping) / (Volume * Quantity).

step_5.title: Compare more products
step_5.details: Use 'Add product' to enter another item and compare values.

step_6.title: Start fresh
step_6.details: Use 'Clear all' to reset the fields and begin again.

instructions.note: You don’t need every field — just enter what you know to compare items faster.
